summary.intent: The user wanted to fix a broken GSD hook setup (statusline blank + Stop hook error on every turn), then run the GSD update to restore the fragmented main-tree install, clean up stale worktrees, and autonomously plan and execute Phase 61 (AAD-Bound Seal Primitive and Cross-Language KAT) through ship.
summary.outcome: Statusline fixed (renamed to .cjs), GSD reinstalled 1.4.3→1.6.0 restoring all missing hooks and the manifest, worktrees removed, Phase 61 fully planned (5 plans / 4 waves, adversarial verification converged), Wave 1 (TS) and Wave 2 (Rust) executed and green with the C-01 merge gate closed; Wave 3 was still running at transcript end.

repo: project package.json has `"type": "module"` — any hook written in CommonJS must use the `.cjs` extension or Node throws `ReferenceError: require is not defined`
GSD hooks are gitignored via `.gitignore:55` (`.claude/hooks/gsd-*`) and must be reinstalled per-clone via the GSD installer; they are never tracked in the repo

vitest is configured with `include: ['src/**/*.ts']` in @cipherbox/crypto — test files must live at `packages/crypto/src/__tests__/`, not `packages/crypto/__tests__/`; the CONTEXT.md and ROADMAP.md both had the wrong path

`scripts/check-vector-parity.sh` has a hardcoded `EXPECTED_VECTORS` array; adding a new vector file (e.g. `tests/vectors/crypto/node-aad.json`) requires a matching entry or the CI parity-check step fails

`sealAesGcmAad` mints a fresh random IV and cannot produce a fixed output — fixed-IV KAT vectors must target the lower-level `encryptAesGcmAad`/`decrypt_aes_gcm_aad` pair, same as how `aes-gcm.json` targets `encrypt_aes_gcm` not `seal_aes_gcm`
`uuid` crate (version 1.23.4) is the only new workspace dependency introduced by Phase 61; there are currently zero AAD consumers anywhere in the codebase — the phase is purely additive
Pre-existing dead-code warnings in `crates/fuse` and `metadata.rs` appear during workspace `cargo build`; they are unrelated to `crates/crypto` changes and are noise

1Password SSH signing requires biometric approval per commit — disabling it locally (`git config commit.gpgsign false`) is necessary for AFK/automated sessions; PRs opened after will show a red signature check until rebased/re-signed

code.finding: Pattern `.claude/hooks/gsd-*` gitignores all GSD-managed hooks — they must be reinstalled via the GSD installer, not restored via git
TS KAT task 2 acceptance criteria originally iterated aad_vectors without a length assertion — vacuous-pass hole; hardened to add `expect(vectors.aad_vectors).toHaveLength(4)` + role-set assertion
TS full-seal KAT task 2 acceptance criteria iterated seal_vectors without a non-empty guard; hardened to add `expect(vectors.seal_vectors.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)`
Rust KAT asserts `!aad_vectors.is_empty()` and `!seal_vectors.is_empty()` — the TS side had no equivalent assertion, creating an asymmetric coverage hole caught by adversarial parity-rigor lens

Documents the stale-path correction: ROADMAP SC#3 and TEST-02 cite `packages/crypto/__tests__/` but plans correctly use `packages/crypto/src/__tests__/` — the roadmap path lies outside vitest's include and would never be discovered

workflow: The GSD commit helper has a known false-negative: it reports failure even when the commit succeeded — always verify with `git log` after each commit
PATTERNS.md is not auto-committed by plan-phase; must be committed explicitly by the orchestrator after the pattern-mapper subagent returns

Worktrees should be disabled for phases where plans share files across waves (e.g. all plans read/extend `node-aad.json` sequentially) — sequential execution on the main tree with warm caches is faster and avoids wave-ordering races

Ultracode adversarial multi-lens plan verification (plan-checker + independent crypto lenses) caught a vacuous-pass KAT hole before execution that would have been silent in production — worth running for any crypto phase
The GSD installer prompts interactively when stale managed files exist; use `--remove` or pre-answer resolution to run non-interactively in automation
VALIDATION.md must be created by the orchestrator (not the planner) before spawning the planner when RESEARCH.md contains a `## Validation Architecture` section
The `--no-transition` flag in execute-phase suppresses auto-chain to phase 62, returning control to the orchestrator for explicit ship-phase dispatch

Disabling git signing locally (`git config --local commit.gpgsign false`) is the right mitigation for AFK sessions with 1Password SSH agent; document the caveat (red signature check on PRs) in the session report

friction: GSD main-tree install was a broken fragment (missing gsd-tools.cjs, gsd-context-monitor.js, most workflows, and gsd-file-manifest.json) — caused MODULE_NOT_FOUND Stop-hook errors on every turn throughout the session until reinstalled
GSD installer prompted interactively about stale files (`gsd_run`, `gsd-ensure-canonical-path.js`) and could not be run unattended; required a second invocation with explicit resolution flags

GSD commit helper false-negatives on every commit required a manual `git log` verification step after each commit to confirm the commit actually landed — added latency to every planning/execution cycle

CONTEXT.md specified the wrong test path (`packages/crypto/__tests__/`) which would have caused plan execution to place test files where vitest would never discover them — only caught because the researcher independently verified vitest config
ROADMAP.md retains the stale test path in SC#3 and TEST-02; the correction is documented in VALIDATION.md but the source-of-truth doc is still wrong
Project statusline broke silently (blank output, no visible error) when the repo adopted `"type": "module"` — the hook crash produced no user-visible diagnostic in the Claude Code UI
